recordsSourceProjection: Estimated from your current life settings
recordsDeleteAllConfirm: This removes local records from this device. You can restore them later by importing an old backup.
recordsArchiveDamagedTitle: This records file can’t be read
recordsArchiveDamagedBody: The file on this device is damaged or unreadable, so new records are not being saved. You can set it aside and start a fresh archive. The original file stays on the device for later recovery by hand.
recordsArchiveQuarantine: Quarantine the damaged archive and start over
recordsArchiveQuarantineConfirm: This does not bring the old records back. It moves the damaged file aside as a .corrupt copy and starts a fresh archive on this device.
recordsArchiveSaveFailedBody: The latest change is on screen but did not reach the file on this device. Try again in a moment — the existing archive was not replaced.
recordsNoObservations: Nothing recorded for this day — the schedule is still here.
recordsEmptyBody: A day shows up here when you start or finish a countdown. Your schedule is not filled in ahead of time.
checkForUpdatesInStore: Check for updates in the Store
updateMirrorNotice: Couldn't reach GitHub directly. The mirror is run by a third party ({{host}}); the installer's signature is still verified before it is applied.
updateNotConfigured: Automatic updates aren't available right now. You can still download the latest version from our website.
updateFailed: Couldn't check for updates. Please try again.
brandRenameTitle: Your shift timer is still here
brandRenameBody: The app is now called DoneAt. Your hours and settings stayed on this device.
reminder: Remind me 15 minutes before off work
launchAtLoginManagedBySystem: Controlled by Windows. Change it in Settings › Apps › Startup.
shortcutInvalid: Include at least one modifier key.
shortcutUpdateFailed: That shortcut couldn't be registered. It may already be in use.
desktopSettingError: Could not update the desktop setting. Please try again.
notificationPrimerBody: DoneAt can remind you about your shift even while its window is hidden.
notificationPrivacyNote: Notifications contain schedule and progress only—never salary.
notificationDeniedBody: Allow notifications in system settings, then enable reminders again.
notificationTestBody: Notifications are ready. We’ll remind you without showing salary.
notificationMilestone75: The hardest part of today is already behind you.
notificationMilestone95: Almost time to close the laptop.
notificationMilestone100: Done for today: {{today}} worked, {{year}} this year. Time to clock off.
futureStartTimeError: Work starts in {{hours}} hours {{minutes}} minutes, so there is nothing to count down yet. Move the start time earlier if you want to begin now.
sameTimeError: Start and end are set to the same time, which leaves no shift to count. Change one of them.
languageFooter: This changes the language inside the app. The name on your Home Screen and the system's own dialogs still follow your device language.
desktopInviteDescription: No need to keep a browser tab open. The desktop app counts quietly in the background, keeps the time remaining in your tray, and lets you know when it’s time for a break—or time to go home.
getAppPlatformsNote: On a computer, Windows and Mac. On a phone or tablet, iPhone and iPad. Same countdown, wherever you install it.
shareText: I'm off work in {{time}}! How about you?
shareWeChatHint: Open WeChat and scan the QR code in the image
landingTagline: Know when your time is yours
landingBody: Set your hours once. The countdown, the progress bar and the running total of what you have earned all update every second. Free, no sign-up, works offline.
landingFeature1Body: Nine to five, a twelve-hour day, or a night shift that runs past midnight — it works out which shift you are in.
landingFeature2Body: Enter a monthly or daily salary and today's earnings accumulate second by second.
landingFeature3Body: Hours and salary stay on this device. The app only contacts Apple when you look at plans, restore a purchase, or turn on iCloud sync.
sharedShiftBanner: Someone shared this shift with you
nextShiftCountdown: Work is done · next shift in {{time}}
lunchPauseNote: Countdown, progress and earnings pause during lunch.
lunchStartNotification: Lunch has started. Your countdown is paused.
lunchEndNotification: Lunch is over. Ready when you are.
overtimeDescription: Choose a later finish time for this shift.
overtimeNoMultiplier: Overtime is estimated at your usual hourly rate, with no overtime multiplier.
microBreakEffectiveTimeNote: Only effective work time counts; lunch and off-hours never trigger reminders.
microBreakMessages: You've been at it for {{minutes}} minutes. Go get some water.
{{minutes}} minutes straight. Stand up and roll your shoulders.
{{minutes}} minutes at the desk. Look at something far away for a bit.
{{minutes}} minutes in. A short walk, then back to it.
woodfishFirstTapSilent: The very first tap stays silent so it never startles a quiet room.
woodfishTapHint: Tap for calm · drag to move
lunchStartReminder: Tell me when the break starts
lunchOutsideShift: This break falls outside your shift, so it will be ignored.
lunchPauseNoteNoSalary: The countdown and progress pause during the break.
desktopStatsHint: A day appears when you start the timer. Hours follow your shift, plus overtime.
desktopStatsEmpty: Start a countdown or tap the woodfish — that day will show up here.
toggleMainWindow: Show or hide the main window
widgetDescription: See your remaining work time at a glance.
liveActivityScheduleNote: We only promise to schedule the reminder for this shift. Focus modes and system limits can still change how it appears.
reviewPromptBody: Would you like to leave a rating in the App Store? It helps more people find the app.
cycleEndSummaryNotificationNote: At the end of each run of scheduled workdays, your clock-off notification summarizes scheduled and edited work time and recorded overtime. Plus only.
cycleEndSummaryNotificationBody: This cycle: {{days}} workdays, {{work}} of scheduled or edited work, and {{overtime}} of recorded overtime. Enjoy your break.
salaryPrivacyNote: Money Earned Today is estimated from this and your shift. Widgets, notifications and Live Activities never show it.
notAWorkdayBody: {{day}} is not in your workdays. You can still start a countdown.
onboardingSystemBody: Time, status and progress — never salary.
mobileNotificationPrimerBody: You don't have to keep watching the app. You'll be reminded at clock-off, at lunch, and when it's time to stand up and move. Reminders are created on this device, and you can turn them off anytime.
sharePrivacyNote: The image and link carry the shift only — never salary.
onboardingShiftBody: Alternating weeks, work/rest rotations, overnight shifts, and lunch breaks are all supported.
onboardingOfflineBody: No account. Works without a network.
onboardingPrivacyBody: No account. The countdown and your records stay on this device unless you choose to load purchases or turn on iCloud sync. Work and salary data are never sent to the developer.
onboardingPrivacyWorkBody: Hours, salary, and records stay on this device. Apple is contacted only for purchases or iCloud sync you start.
overtimeTimeLeftCaption: left of the overtime you set
notificationCapabilityNote: Without notification permission, only the Lock Screen Live Activity can appear. The countdown itself keeps running.
shareComposerNote: Opens the system share sheet with the image and link attached.
nativeNoThirdPartySDK: The native iOS app includes no third-party SDKs; shared rules come from this MIT-licensed project.
scheduleClassicDescription: Choose the weekdays you normally work.
scheduleRotationDescription: A repeating run of work and rest days.
scheduleOffDescription: Decide each day. No set weekend.
alternatingCurrentWeekDescription: This sets the starting point for the single-rest and double-rest week rotation.
singleWeekWorkdayDescription: Only applies to single-rest weeks. The selected day is the weekend day you work; the other weekend day is off. In double-rest weeks, both Saturday and Sunday are off.
scheduleOffSummaryNote: Calendar totals are hidden while scheduling is off; daily pay remains available when salary is enabled.
scheduleSharedRulesNote: The timer, reminders and widgets all follow this schedule.
nonWorkdayTapAgain: Rest day · tap again to time today
invalidLunchMessage: Lunch must fall completely inside the shift before the countdown can start.
enableSalaryDescription: Off by default; salary stays on this device.
onboardingEverywhereBody: Follow the last stretch from Dynamic Island, widgets and the Lock Screen.
onboardingEverywhereBodyTablet: Follow the last stretch from widgets and the Lock Screen.
onboardingAdaptiveBody: Use the collapsible iPad sidebar or a focused two-column layout in landscape.
onboardingLandscapeBody: In landscape the countdown goes full screen — just the clock and the bar, nothing else.
onboardingSidebarBody: Collapse the sidebar and the countdown fills the display — just the clock and the bar, nothing else.
onboardingReadyBody: Set your hours and weekdays, then the clock starts.
biometricsUnavailableHint: Biometrics unavailable — find {{app}} in the Settings app list to turn it on
biometricsNotEnrolledHint: {{biometry}} isn’t set up — add it in Settings to unlock with it
biometricsLockoutHint: {{biometry}} is locked — unlock once with your device passcode to re-enable it
applyScheduleMessage: “From the next shift only” keeps today as it is. “Change today too” also clears today’s early clock-in, early clock-off and overtime.
keepAtLeastOneWorkday: Keep one weekday, or pick no schedule.
switchToUnscheduledHint: No fixed weekdays? Switch to no schedule.
unscheduledBody: Start with the hours you already set.
onboardingScheduleBody: Pick a pattern, or decide each day.
rulesErrorBanner: Countdown rules are unavailable. Your schedule is still on.
onboardingRemindersBody: Lunch pauses the countdown. Reminders reach you without keeping the app open.
onboardingLunchNotifyHint: You'll be notified when lunch starts and ends.
onboardingRemindersMoreInSettings: More reminder options are in Settings.
debugResetNextLaunchDetail: The next launch clears all app settings and opens the welcome screen.
debugCaptureScenariosDetail: Each scenario starts on Friday, Aug 23 at 14:22 and continues in real time. Lunch, health and off-work progress reminders are enabled.
debugLiveActivityDetail: Starts a real Live Activity for a 09:00–19:00 capture shift.
debugSeedRecordsDetail: Writes a few weeks of clock-ins, one leave day, overtime, a life profile, and two focus tasks. Charts and Focus still need Plus.
debugSeedRecordsDone: Sample records are on this device.
recordsTimeZoneMigrateConfirm: Calendar dates stay where they are. Nine o’clock is still nine o’clock, now read in this time zone. A countdown that is already running keeps the previous one until it ends.
recordsTimeZoneFooter: The calendar keeps the days you wrote. Travel does not move them. If this is home now, you can switch to this device’s time zone.
plusIntroTitle: See the shape of your time
plusIntroBody: The timer and your recent week stay free. Plus opens the full year, your working life, editing, focus, and iCloud sync.
plusAutoRenew: Subscriptions renew automatically until you cancel. The yearly plan can include a 7-day trial. After the trial, the yearly price applies. Lifetime is a one-time purchase and does not cancel an active subscription.
plusLifetimeWhileSubscribed: Buying lifetime does not cancel your current subscription. After this purchase, turn the subscription off in Manage subscription.
plusAlsoHasSubscription: You also have a subscription that is still renewing. Manage it here until it ends.
plusLifeLocked: See work on a longer scale
plusEditLocked: Change a day that already passed
recordsOwnTime: Waking time that is not work
recordsConflictCopy: Another device also changed this day.
lifeEstimatedPast: Past weeks use the schedule from that time.
lifeProjectedFuture: Future weeks assume the current rhythm.
lifeOutsideZone: Some days were written in a different time zone.
syncOn: Syncing through your iCloud private database.
syncNeedNetwork: Connect to the internet and try again.
syncNoCloudRecords: This Apple Account has no records to restore.
syncAccountChanged: This Apple Account changed. Sync is paused.
focusNoRoom: There is not enough time left in this shift for that.
focusEndedAtBoundary: This focus block reached a lunch or clock-off boundary.
syncRestoreDetail: Bring the records from your iCloud onto this device.
syncDeleteiCloudDetail: Removes them from iCloud, for every device on this Apple Account.
syncRemoveDeviceDetail: Removes them from this device only.
syncDisableConfirm: Stop syncing on this device? The records already in iCloud stay there, and this device keeps the ones it has.
syncDeleteiCloudConfirm: Delete all records from iCloud and every device signed in to this Apple Account, including this device? This cannot be undone.
syncRemoveDeviceConfirm: Delete the records on this device? Anything already in iCloud stays there, and Restore brings it back.
syncNeedsPlus: iCloud sync is part of DoneAt Plus.
syncFailed: Sync could not finish. Try again in a moment.
lifeProfileFooter: These numbers draw the grid. They stay on this device unless you turn on iCloud sync.
lifeEmptyBody: A birth year and a retirement age are enough to draw your working life, week by week.
focusStopConfirm: Stop this block? The time so far is kept and the task stays open.
focusEmptyBody: Add one thing you want to finish today. Each block runs {{minutes}} minutes and stops at lunch or clock-off.
recordsHeatScale: Color depth shows hours worked, from less to more.
recordsHeatWithoutColor: Days you changed carry an outline, and the list below gives the same hours as text.
recordsClearDayDetail: Goes back to the schedule and holiday calendar for this day.
recordsClearDayConfirm: Undo your change to this day? It goes back to what the schedule and holiday calendar say.
recordsReplaceHoursConfirm: This replaces the hours recorded for the day.
plusGracePeriod: There is a problem with the payment. Access continues for now, and updating the payment method in the App Store keeps it.
plusUnavailable: The App Store did not send the plans back.
plusOwnedBody: Lifetime is a one-time purchase, so there is nothing to renew and nothing to manage.
plusBenefitLife: A life canvas from birth to retirement
plusBenefitSync: Records synced through your own iCloud
recordsMetricWorkdaysHelp: Days that contain an actual work record. Schedule-only estimates are not counted.
recordsMetricWorkHelp: Regular work is recorded scheduled work time, excluding breaks and overtime.
recordsMetricOvertimeHelp: Overtime is recorded work beyond the regular scheduled segments.
recordsMetricBreakHelp: Breaks are gaps between work segments, including the lunch duration configured for that date.
recordsMetricSleepHelp: Sleep comes from your life profile or Health estimate and is not counted as waking time.
recordsMetricFreeHelp: Free time is waking time left after regular work, overtime, work breaks, and sleep.
recordsLifeSetupBody: A birth year is enough to start. Skip any date you do not know.
recordsLockedDay: Plus is needed to see this date
recordsLockedScale: Plus is needed to see this view
recordsLockedSummary: Plus is needed to see these totals
recordsEditPlusHint: Editing a day from Records is a Plus feature. The timer still works as it does today.
recordsOwnerAuthReason: Confirm it is you to continue
focusDeleteTaskBody: Its completed focus history will stay in Records.
focusPlanTodayBody: Place tasks and breaks anywhere in this shift.
focusPlanIntroTitle: Shape the shift before it shapes you
focusPlanIntroBody: Each tile is {{minutes}} minutes of effective work time. Lunch and other schedule gaps remain open automatically.
focusPlanUnavailable: No pomodoro blocks in this shift
focusPlanUnavailableBody: Open this page on a workday with at least one full {{minutes}}-minute work block.
focusTemplateSaveBody: This saves the task and break layout, not today's completion state.
focusPlanAddTasksFirst: Add a task on the Focus page, then return here to place it.
plusThanksBody: Plus is ready. We hope the time it helps you reclaim feels unmistakably yours.
focusNoNextTask: Add another task to start the next focus block.
focusNextBreakBody: Take the next step when you are ready. The break will not start by itself.
focusNextFocusBody: Your break is complete. Choose a task to begin the next round.
focusNotificationPermissionDenied: Notifications are off, so you may miss the end of this timer. You can turn them on in system settings.
focusNotificationSchedulingFailed: We couldn't schedule the end-of-timer notification. You can try again when you start the next timer.
focusNotificationRetryHint: The current request is not rescheduled here; the next timer start will try again.
focusNotificationRetryNextLaunch: We'll try again the next time you start a timer.
focusTimerSettingsHint: Set durations for new focus timers and breaks.
focusTimerSettingsBody: These settings apply to new timers. A running timer and a saved plan keep their own timing.
focusTimerSettingsLockedRunning: Finish the running timer before changing its cadence.
focusTimerSettingsLockedPlan: A saved plan uses these durations. Finish or clear that plan before changing them.
recordsOperationFileUnavailable: The selected file is not available to this app. Choose it again from Files.
recordsOperationReadFailed: We couldn't read that file. Nothing changed.
recordsOperationInvalidDocument: This file isn't a valid DoneAt records backup. Nothing changed.
recordsOperationUnsupportedVersion: This backup was made by a newer version. Update the app before importing it.
recordsOperationPreviewFailed: We couldn't inspect this backup. Nothing changed.
recordsOperationImportFailed: We couldn't import the backup. Your existing records are unchanged.
recordsOperationExportFailed: We couldn't create the backup file. Your records are unchanged.
recordsOperationOwnerAuthenticationFaile: We couldn't confirm this action. No records were changed.
recordsConflictReviewLegacyVersions: This conflict has one older copy. Review both versions before choosing.
recordsConflictReviewVersions: Compare the two versions, then choose which one to keep. Nothing changes until you choose.
recordsConflictChooseOtherFields: Choose fields from the other version
